notes: Only primary paper sources used. Publisher cache is an abstract/subscription page, not full paper text. Open primary working papers retrieved from Banco Central del Uruguay (original, August 2019; title variant: Using behavioral insights in early childhood interventions: The effects of Crianza Positiva text and voice messaging program on parenting behavior and competences) and Universidad de Montevideo (replication; title variant: The Replication of a Parenting Behavioral Change Communication Intervention during the COVID-19 Pandemic: Too Much or Too Little Information?). Authors, intervention, and study years match, but supplied published-page locators cannot be checked against these versions; target_match remains null rather than asserting version equivalence. Extracted the first/main ITT specification consistently. Original p is the printed cluster-adjusted p in column (2) for the column (1) coefficient; other printed original p values use MHT/randomization inference. Replication coefficients are printed in outcome units; no conversion to requested standardized beta made. Replication exact p values are not printed; socialization has only the printed star bound. Original Table 5 descriptive outcome counts (physical 338, didactic 358, socialization 318) are not asserted as analytic regression n. Replication 687 recruited families and 602 second-follow-up respondents are not asserted as target-test analytic n. Published abstract narrative verdict is study-wide. Published full-PDF endpoints returned non-PDF content; OpenAlex reported no OA location. No statistics calculated.
